- **LLM-as-judge is widely used but rarely validated.** AIQ reports only 11% of judge users have calibrated the judge against human labels; the rest treat judge scores as ground truth. **Single source, not corroborated.** [AIQ](https://aiqreport.com/2026/state-of-agent-evals)
